content.title: US Military Officer Arrested for Espionage in UK
content.caption: A US soldier who was arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia has been taken into custody by the US military.

slides.heading: US Military Officer Arrested for Espionage in UK
slides.text: A US soldier who was arrested in the UK on suspicion of spying for Russia has been taken into custody by the US military.

slides.heading: What Happened
slides.text: Lt Col Brandon Carroll Tyner, 41, was detained by British counter-terrorism police on 10 November in Gloucestershire over allegations relating to espionage.

slides.heading: Why It Matters
slides.text: The arrest was part of an investigation by UK Counter Terrorism Policing, working with authorities including the US military and the FBI.
